error_contract.domain_errors: Existing RECAP_* and other domain error codes are preserved.
error_contract.mcp: Tool failures are tools/call results with isError=true; malformed JSON-RPC requests remain protocol errors.

pagination_contract.arguments: offset and limit; retain filters and recap ranking_revision when continuing
pagination_contract.compaction: Result and request compaction defer whole trailing items with truncated=true. JSON records and nested evidence stay whole; if a request cannot fit a single complete item, it fails with AI_CONTEXT_LIMIT.
pagination_contract.completion: Follow non-null next_offset even on an empty page. A full last page may require one empty probe. null ends the current result set except end_reason=offset_limit, which requires a narrower query.
pagination_contract.consistency: Offsets require unchanged filters and data. Recap ranking_revision rejects changed rankings; other tools should be restarted after source or index changes.
pagination_contract.positions: result_offset refers to the row before privacy filtering; next_offset is the next unread position, not offset plus returned_count
pagination_contract.results: items (ocr_results for snapshot details), offset, limit, returned_count, next_offset; total only when known

time_contract.calendar: Recap dates retain their recorded time zone and absolute day/period boundaries. Inspect calendar on a day, or calendars[date] on date lists and search results. Legacy days use rule=recorded_bounds with time_zone=null.

tools.description: List screenshots in [start_ms, end_ms), ordered by captured_at_ms then screenshot_id. Times are Unix milliseconds; null means unknown. max_records aliases limit. Paging: use next_offset with unchanged filters even after short/empty/truncated pages. null ends results except end_reason=offset_limit (narrow filters). result_offset precedes privacy filtering. Restart after data/index changes.

max_records.description: Legacy alias for limit; omit when supplying limit

tools.name: get_snapshots_by_time_range

tools.description: Read screenshot_id, returning status=found, record (captured_at_ms) and paged ocr_results (ocr_processed_at_ms). Times are Unix milliseconds. Missing or privacy-rejected reads fail with SNAPSHOT_NOT_FOUND or PRIVACY_REJECTED. Paging: use next_offset with unchanged filters even after short/empty/truncated pages. null ends results except end_reason=offset_limit (narrow filters). result_offset precedes privacy filtering. Restart after data/index changes.

include_coords.description: Include OCR bounding box coordinates (default false)

screenshot_id.description: screenshot_id returned by another tool; OCR row IDs cannot be used here

tools.name: get_snapshot_details

tools.description: Search visible words with space-separated keywords, e.g. 保存路径 or save location; a full Chinese question becomes one phrase. fuzzy tolerates spelling/OCR errors. screenshot_id identifies evidence, ocr_id the text row; captured_at_ms is capture time, ocr_processed_at_ms recognition completion (Unix milliseconds). match_evidence explains the representative OCR row before privacy filtering: relevance_score, matched_terms, literal_terms, match_type=literal|approximate|bigram_only, phrase_matched, optional matched/total_bigram_groups. confidence measures OCR confidence, not relevance. Paging: use next_offset with unchanged filters even after short/empty/truncated pages. null ends results except end_reason=offset_limit (narrow filters). result_offset precedes privacy filtering. Restart after data/index changes.

query.description: Visible words or phrases; use space-separated keywords rather than a full question

tools.name: search_ocr_text

tools.description: Search screen appearance with Chinese-CLIP image embeddings; use search_ocr_text for visible words. Results use screenshot_id and captured_at_ms (Unix milliseconds). Time filters exclude unknown capture times. Paging: use next_offset with unchanged filters even after short/empty/truncated pages. null ends results except end_reason=offset_limit (narrow filters). result_offset precedes privacy filtering. Restart after data/index changes.
tools.name: search_nl

tools.description: List smart clusters with cluster_id, assignment counts, stored summaries, and explicit Unix-millisecond created_at_ms, updated_at_ms and last_assigned_at_ms fields. Unknown times are null. Paging: use next_offset with unchanged filters even after short/empty/truncated pages. null ends results except end_reason=offset_limit (narrow filters). result_offset precedes privacy filtering. Restart after data/index changes.
tools.name: get_smart_clusters

tools.description: Get smart-cluster screenshots with joined OCR text, screenshot_id, captured_at_ms and assigned_at_ms (Unix milliseconds). Results are ordered by rerank score then screenshot_id. Use offset/limit; page/page_size remain legacy aliases. When continuing with next_offset, omit page. Paging: use next_offset with unchanged filters even after short/empty/truncated pages. null ends results except end_reason=offset_limit (narrow filters). result_offset precedes privacy filtering. Restart after data/index changes.

include_empty_ocr.description: Include snapshots that have no OCR text (default false)

tools.name: get_smart_cluster_ocr_corpus

tools.description: Get the stored AI-generated summary for a smart cluster, if one exists.
tools.name: get_smart_cluster_summary

tools.description: List recorded daily recap dates, newest first, from the most recent 730 non-deleted dates. Each YYYY-MM-DD date retains its saved calendar; inspect calendars[date] for the recorded time zone and UTC boundaries. A listed date may have pending or stale periods; use get_recap_day to read available content. Does not generate recaps. Paging: use next_offset with unchanged filters even after short/empty/truncated pages. null ends results except end_reason=offset_limit (narrow filters). result_offset precedes privacy filtering. Restart after data/index changes.
tools.name: get_recap_days

tools.description: Read saved, corrected activities, period overviews and sources (screenshot_id, captured_at_ms). YYYY-MM-DD uses the returned saved calendar's fixed zone and day/period boundaries. Times are Unix milliseconds. Activities are chronological; batch_start_ms selects a period. Empty/pending periods do not prove inactivity. Does not generate or edit recaps. Verify facts with get_snapshot_details. Activity start_ms/end_ms are first/last cited capture times; span_ms is their difference, not work duration (time_semantics=evidence_observation_span; observation_kind=instant|span). sources cites the activity; details[].evidence_ids cites each fact. member_ids lists assigned screenshots, possibly beyond the cited span. membership_status: complete, filtered by privacy, incomplete directory, or unavailable legacy data. Verify members with get_snapshot_details. Paging: use next_offset with unchanged filters even after short/empty/truncated pages. null ends results except end_reason=offset_limit (narrow filters). result_offset precedes privacy filtering. Restart after data/index changes.

batch_start_ms.description: Optional period start from a previous response, in Unix milliseconds

tools.name: get_recap_day

tools.description: Search saved, corrected activities by keyword, semantic meaning, or hybrid. Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD filters use saved calendars[date] zones/bounds. Hybrid runs keywords over all filtered activities plus available vectors; semantic failure preserves keywords. coverage counts unique chunks and activities globally, in query_scope and per scoped date; missing_dates identifies gaps. execution reports requested mode, branches, match counts before paging, fallback_reason and the semantic top-200 cap. total counts fused candidates; keyword_rank=null means no keyword match. index_progress describes index construction. Sources use screenshot_id/captured_at_ms (Unix milliseconds); verify facts with get_snapshot_details. Does not generate recaps or index. Activity start_ms/end_ms are first/last cited capture times; span_ms is their difference, not work duration (time_semantics=evidence_observation_span; observation_kind=instant|span). sources cites the activity; details[].evidence_ids cites each fact. member_ids lists assigned screenshots, possibly beyond the cited span. membership_status: complete, filtered by privacy, incomplete directory, or unavailable legacy data. Verify members with get_snapshot_details. Paging: use next_offset with unchanged filters even after short/empty/truncated pages. null ends results except end_reason=offset_limit (narrow filters). result_offset precedes privacy filtering. Restart after data/index changes.

include_details.description: Include saved key facts in retrieval

process_names.description: Match any cited source process name, case-insensitively; empty array means all processes

ranking_revision.description: When paging, pass ranking_revision from the previous result. If results changed, restart at offset 0 without this field.
